topic: Largest peninsula in the world (Arabian Peninsula)
policy_note: Template ledger. Every quiz needs: the answer (core), every on-screen number (record), each story beat (detail), framing lines (framing) — all traced to ≥ 2 independent publishers. Replace everything for a real episode.

un_m49.title: Standard country or area codes (M49) — Western Asia

claims.text: The Arabian Peninsula is the largest peninsula in the world.
vo: which is the largest peninsula in the world

claims.text: Its area is about 3.2 million km² (Britannica: about 1,250,000 square miles ≈ 3.24 million km²).
vo: around three point two million square kilometres

claims.text: Seven countries lie on the peninsula — Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Oman, the UAE, Qatar, Bahrain and Kuwait — and Saudi Arabia occupies most of it.
vo: seven countries share it and saudi arabia covers most of that land
screen: Saudi Arabia covers most of the peninsula; Yemen, Oman, the UAE, Qatar, Bahrain and Kuwait share the rest.

claims.text: An equal-area projection preserves relative sizes; Mercator (conformal) inflates areas away from the equator.
vo: on this equal-area map that is bigger than india's peninsula and scandinavia put together
screen: Equal-area projection: sizes compare truthfully — unlike Mercator.

myths.reality: The Indian peninsula is smaller by area than Arabia.
